prompt: Write a Commodore 64 BASIC program that asks the user for their name with INPUT and then prints HELLO followed by the name five times using a FOR/NEXT loop.
assertions: Uses INPUT with a string variable (name ending in $)
Uses a FOR ... NEXT loop iterating 5 times
Concatenates/prints HELLO together with the name variable
Is valid runnable C64 BASIC V2 (no non-existent keywords)
